decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey detached dwellinghouse, by reason of its excessive size and footprint, would represent an overdevelopment of the site that would not adequately comply with Council's Housing Standards and Guidelines. The proposal fails to provide a sufficient level and quality of private amenity space, and would result in an overprovision of off-street parking, detrimental to the residential amenities of the future occupiers of this proposed family-sized accommodation. The proposal is therefore contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and T.1.4.

Condition : 2 - The proposed two-storey detached dwellinghouse, by reason of size, position and appearance, would represent an unduly overbearing and obtrusive development on this prominent corner, and would be out of character and detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1. and H.4.1.
description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING BUNGALOW AND ERECTION OF A DETACHED TWO-STOREY DWELLINGHOUSE WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING
